title: Which bridge type spans farthest?
examples: Which type of bridge can span the longest distance?
How far can an arch bridge span?
Why are suspension bridges used for the longest gaps?

explain.say: Each bridge type has a limit to how far one span can reach. Beam bridges, even huge steel or concrete box girders, top out at around 300 metres, because a longer beam spends its strength holding up its own weight.

faq.q: Which type of bridge can span the longest distance?
faq.a: Suspension bridges. The record holder, the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge in Turkey, has a main span of 2,023 metres, far longer than any cable-stayed span.
asks: What is the longest bridge span?

faq.q: How far can a beam bridge span?
faq.a: The longest beam or box-girder spans are around 300 metres. Beyond that a beam becomes too heavy, so long crossings use many spans or switch to another type.
asks: What is the longest girder bridge?

faq.q: How far can arch and cantilever bridges span?
faq.a: Both reach a little over 500 metres. The Quebec Bridge's 549-metre cantilever span has been the longest since 1917, and the longest steel and concrete arches span roughly 550 to 600 metres.
asks: How long can an arch bridge be?

faq.q: How far can a cable-stayed bridge span?
faq.a: The longest cable-stayed spans are a little over a kilometre, such as Russky Bridge in Russia at 1,104 metres.
asks: What is the longest cable-stayed bridge?

faq.q: Why are suspension bridges used for the longest gaps?
faq.a: Their main cables carry the load purely in tension, which steel wire does extremely efficiently, and a cable can sag across a huge gap. Other types fight bending or squeezing that grows quickly with span.
asks: Why can suspension bridges be so long?

facts: The 1915 Çanakkale Bridge in Turkey, opened in 2022, has the world's longest bridge span, 2,023 metres.
The Quebec Bridge in Canada, finished in 1917, has had the world's longest cantilever span, 549 metres, for over a century.

quiz.say: Engineers must cross a strait 1,800 metres wide with a single span. Which bridge type would they choose?
quiz.show: One span across 1,800 metres: which type?
quiz.why: Only suspension bridges have single spans well beyond one and a half kilometres.

wrong.1: Beam spans top out around 300 metres.
wrong.2: The longest arches span roughly 600 metres at most.
